post.originalText:
让 Opus 5.5 讲述人类从诞生到制作出它的故事 🤯

花了 2个prompt，3小时。max effort，~130M token（大概是 $60 API 价格）。 https://t.co/N2o12V5tBu

sourceMaterials.text: @Schneizellll Pure Javascript! No video/image generation at all.
sourceMaterials.author: songkeys

sourceMaterials.text:
@Schneizellll Sure. It's really simple:
First turn:
Create a short origami / doodle-style animation showing humanity’s development, progress, and civilization from birth to the present, and ultimately the hatching of AI. AI then gradually develops and advances, eventually hatching today’s Opus 5.5 (you). Style: doodly, cute, warm, strongly narrative, no spoken language (simple text is OK, but don’t use too much explanatory/narrative text, because I want different civilizations to be able to understand it), poetic, moving, high quality.

And then it gave me some draft scenes. I gave some modification suggestions. Then the video is out! (So I believe it can actually one-shot it if giving clear instruction in the first run.)
